items.title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Cadences
items.summary: In the latest Anthropic Economic Index report, we look at when people come to Claude, what they produce with it, and how they perceive AI’s impact on their work.

items.title: Paving the way for AI agents in biology
items.summary: In this Anthropic Science post, Laura Luebbert argues that we need to make biological data infrastructure more agent-friendly.
items.title_ko: 생물학 분야에서 AI 에이전트의 길을 열다
items.summary_ko: 생물학 연구·실험 워크플로우에 AI 에이전트가 어떻게 활용될 수 있는지, 그 방향과 안전 고려사항을 짚는 Anthropic의 연구.

items.title: Making Claude a chemist
items.summary: Anthropic is working with world-class synthetic, computational, and analytical chemists to make Claude better at chemistry. In this post, we share our first work as part of this effort.
items.title_ko: Claude를 화학자로 만들기
items.summary_ko: Claude가 화학 문제 풀이와 합성 경로 설계 같은 전문 화학 업무를 수행하도록 훈련·평가한 Anthropic의 연구.

items.title: Anthropic's core views on AI safety
items.summary: AI progress may lead to transformative AI systems in the next decade, but we do not yet understand how to make such systems safe and aligned with human values. In response, we are pursuing a variety of research directions aimed at better understanding, evaluating, and aligning AI systems.
items.title_ko: AI 안전성에 대한 핵심 견해 — 언제·왜·무엇을·어떻게
items.summary_ko: AI 발전은 향후 10년 내 변혁적 AI 시스템으로 이어질 수 있지만, 그러한 시스템을 안전하게 만들고 인간 가치와 정렬하는 방법은 아직 모릅니다. 이를 위해 Anthropic이 추구하는 여러 연구 방향을 정리한 문서.

items.title: AI to defend critical infrastructure
items.summary: AI could help defenders of critical infrastructure identify the vulnerabilities that attackers might exploit—and close them before they are exploited. items.title: Reverse engineering Claude's CVE-2026-2796 exploit
items.summary: This post dives deep into how Claude wrote an exploit for one of the vulnerabilities it found in Firefox.

items.title: Introducing Claude Corps
items.summary: Anthropic is launching Claude Corps, a national fellowship program for people early in their careers who are passionate about extending the benefits of AI to communities across America.
items.title_ko: Claude Corps 출범
items.summary_ko: AI의 혜택을 미국 전역 지역사회로 확장하는 데 관심 있는 초년 경력자를 위한 국가 펠로우십 프로그램 'Claude Corps'를 시작합니다.

items.title: DXC integrates Claude into systems regulated industries rely on
items.summary: Anthropic is announcing a multi-year global alliance with DXC Technology, one of the world’s largest IT services companies.
items.title_ko: DXC와 글로벌 제휴 — 은행·항공 등 규제 산업에 Claude 통합
items.summary_ko: 세계 최대 IT 서비스 기업 중 하나인 DXC Technology와 다년 글로벌 제휴를 체결합니다. 은행, 항공사 등 규제가 강한 산업의 기존 시스템에 Claude를 통합하는 것이 목표입니다.

items.title: TCS and Anthropic bring Claude to regulated industries
items.summary: Anthropic is announcing a partnership with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). TCS will provide Claude to 50,000 of its own employees across 56 countries; build Claude-powered products for clients in financial services, healthcare, the public sector, and other regulated industries; and join the Claude Partner Network.
items.title_ko: TCS와 Anthropic, 규제 산업에 Claude 도입 위해 파트너십 체결
items.summary_ko: Tata Consultancy Services(TCS)와 파트너십을 발표합니다. TCS는 56개국 5만 명 자사 임직원에게 Claude를 제공하고, 금융·헬스케어·공공 등 규제 산업 고객을 위한 Claude 기반 제품을 구축하며, Claude Partner Network에 합류합니다.

items.title: Measuring LLMs’ ability to develop exploits
items.summary: We've developed two new, challenging academic benchmarks measuring AI models’ ability to develop exploits, and an updated version of the benchmark measuring smart contract exploitation.

items.title: Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats
items.summary: We’ve spent the past year investigating how threat actors are weaponizing AI to conduct cyber operations. Today, we’re sharing a new analysis that maps these real-world attacks onto the MITRE ATT&CK framework, a database of tactics and techniques used by cyberattackers.
items.title_ko: AI 기반 사이버 위협 매핑 — LLM ATT&CK Navigator의 통찰
items.summary_ko: 지난 1년간 위협 행위자들이 AI를 사이버 작전에 어떻게 무기화했는지 조사한 결과를, 공격자 전술·기법 데이터베이스 MITRE ATT&CK 프레임워크에 매핑한 분석을 공개합니다.

items.title: Anthropic partners with the Gates Foundation
items.summary: Anthropic is partnering with the Gates Foundation to commit $200 million in grant funding, Claude usage credits, and technical support for programs in global health, life sciences, education, and economic mobility over the next four years.

items.summary_ko: Anthropic은 신뢰할 수 있고, 해석 가능하며, 제어 가능한 AI 시스템 구축을 목표로 하는 AI 안전 · 연구 회사입니다.

items.title: What 81,000 people told us about the economics of AI

items.title: Developing nuclear safeguards for AI through public-private partnership
items.summary: Together with the NNSA and DOE national laboratories, we have co-developed a classifier—an AI system that automatically categorizes content—that distinguishes between concerning and benign nuclear-related conversations with 96% accuracy in preliminary testing.
